mentl/720c368:
The 6.3 sweep's storage-carrier family covered record field, list element,
tuple, variant, default parameter and handler state. Two carriers were
untested. The fanout branch refuses correctly. The resume value does not.

A closure performing E, handed out of an arm through resume and called
under `with !E`, checks clean and runs — exit 7, the outer handler
answering, so the perform is real and the negation is not enforced. Write
`with Pure` on the op's returned fn type and the identical program refuses.
The same closure written inline is caught either way.

So the subsumption machinery is reached at the resume site and works; there
is nothing to subsume under. An unannotated fn type in a return position
mints a free row var, and the directional meet fires only on a concrete cap
— deliberately, because a var-tailed param row is the flow channel map's f
needs, and masking it once convicted 297 sites.

The design is variance: a param is a demand the caller fills, so its
unannotated row stays a var; a return is a promise about what the produced
value may do, so its unannotated row should cap at Pure. Every other
carrier already behaves that way.

Two crucibles pin the rule that works — explicit cap refuses, pure
transport is admitted. Crown 58/0. The default is named with the blast
radius as its next probe.
